name: Hotel President Wilson
positioning: Hotel President Wilson, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Geneva: a lakefront hotel facing Lake Geneva, within walking distance of the city center, with a La Mer spa, a terrace pool and the Royal Penthouse Floor
best_for: Travelers who want a lakefront base within walking distance of central Geneva
Spa lovers who want La Mer Signature treatments
Visitors to the UN and other international organizations

facts.text: The hotel faces Lake Geneva, minutes from the parks and boutiques of rue du Rhône.
The hotel has a prime lakefront location within walking distance of the city center, in a very peaceful area.
The hotel is close to international organizations including the UN, as well as diplomatic missions and consulates.
The hotel was designed by architect and hotelier Marcel Jacquignon and first opened in 1962.
It reopened in 1996 as Hotel President Wilson, named in honor of Woodrow Wilson, the 28th President of the United States.
Public areas are characterized by three themes conceived by South Korean artist Jae-Hyo Lee: water, surrounding landscape and light.
Bathrooms are marble, with Byredo bath amenities.
Spa body treatments include scrubs, massages, foot reflexology, lymphatic drainage and a hammam ritual.
A Tom Ford beauty boutique is located at the hotel.
Bayview offers a seasonal menu of locally sourced products with views of Lake Geneva and the Alps.
Arabesque serves traditional Lebanese cuisine in an oriental setting.

highlights.text: The hotel has the first spa in Switzerland to feature La Mer skincare products and Signature treatments.
The Royal Penthouse Floor stretches across the entire 8th floor.
The heated outdoor pool is on the first-floor terrace and overlooks Lake Geneva, the Alps and the Mont Blanc range.
A private Spa Suite with steam room, sauna and relaxing area is available exclusively with spa packages.
Suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the lake, pool and city.

considerations.text: The swimming pool is open during summertime, not year-round.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the premium Geneva location.
WhataHotel notes the formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers.
